resources.string: Screen & controllers
Play over Wi-Fi
Other phones become controllers and a computer or TV shows the game. Everyone on the same network, no app needed.
Extra controller
Point another phone camera at the code. It opens a controller in the browser: players 2 to 4.
Computer or TV
Open this address in the browser and type the code. A keyboard or controller plugged into it can play too.
